data.body:
Fix pushed for review: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2632 (commit 8a6cf7e5e6eb, Change-Id I70e42c7b47cc014734c346d52a91ce00bddae47e).

One-line change to tests/unit/workflow/test_terraform_plan_review_tools.py: a function-scope pytest.importorskip("hcl2") plus an explanatory comment, immediately before the real-parse refutation query.

Local gates:
- make lint -> exit 0
- make typecheck -> exit 0 (763 source files)
- make test (CI's gating selection) -> 19393 passed, 63 skipped, 0 failed. 4 teardown ERRORS were self-inflicted: the _no_repo_commits guard saw HEAD move ee2c54f881 -> 8a6cf7e5e6 because I committed while the suite was running. Re-run of exactly those 4 with a stable HEAD: 4 passed, 3 skipped.

Acceptance criteria:
- AC1 met: the guard sits before the real-parse query; the other 15 tests still RUN without the extra (15 passed, only 1 skipped).
- AC2 met: 15 passed, 1 skipped ('SKIPPED [1] ...:123: could not import hcl2').
- AC3 met: with python-hcl2==8.1.3 installed, 16 passed.
- AC4 met: with REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1 and the extra absent, tests/_extra_guard.py:58 raises ImportError (a hard error, NOT a skip). With the extra installed plus REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1 (the real gating-lane config), 16 passed.

Not closing this ticket: per policy the close waits on Verified +1 on 2632. Leaving it in_progress for the operator.
